blocks.given: input whose largest count has fewer digits than N
blocks.then: counts are right-aligned in a field of N characters instead of the width of the largest count

assert.text: with counts 12 and 3 and --width 5, the lines are '   12 apple' and '    3 pear'
the field never truncates: when N is smaller than the widest count, the width of the widest count is used

verify.new_aspect: N smaller than the widest count (--width 1 with a count of 120)
verify.reason: the count was not truncated but the width was 1 + widest; A2 rewritten from the observed output

verify.new_aspect: three-digit count and non-ASCII line text
verify.reason: padding is still computed in characters of the count only
